vectors.title: An amount given twice in one object
derivation: The first input rate has "amount": "100" and then "amount": "1.25".
A parser keeping the last value would price at 1.25, one keeping the first at 100: the bytes are rejected (JSON-1).

Bytes that do not hash to the expected sha256
The expected digest is written with capital letters
derivation: The right digest of text.json is 9427faa24c8cd47892f9da51ae9205ed1a3ad98d5a3468cabf95ced5be314237.
The caller supplies the same digest in capitals. A digest is 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; any other spelling is hash-mismatch (VAL-2).

vectors.title: A sidecar line with a digest and a file name
derivation: The sidecar text is the line `<digest>  catalog.json` that sha256sum writes, with its line feed.
The digest is the first whitespace-delimited field of the first line, and it is the right one: the catalog loads (VAL-2).

vectors.title: A sidecar whose digest is in capitals
derivation: The sidecar line is the right digest in capitals, then the file name.
The first field is not 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters: hash-mismatch (VAL-2).

vectors.title: A sidecar from which no digest can be read
derivation: The sidecar text is "not a digest". Its first field, "not", is not a digest: hash-mismatch (VAL-2).

A version already held, with different bytes
derivation: A new client loads text.json, version 2026.11.04.1, and then next.json, version 2026.11.05.1: both load, and next.json is the last good copy.

It then loads dated.json, a valid catalog with the first version and other bytes. The client holds that version, though it is no longer in force: version-conflict (VAL-2). It is not hash-mismatch: no expected sha256 was supplied.
The last good copy is still next.json (VAL-1).
Loading next.json again, the same bytes, is not a conflict.

vectors.title: currency is the number 5
derivation: The first input rate has "currency": 5. A member other than amount and per that is not a string is invalid-structure (VAL-4), not unknown-currency.

vectors.title: The bytes begin with a UTF-8 byte order mark
derivation: The file is a valid catalog preceded by the bytes EF BB BF (JSON-1).

vectors.title: The bytes are not valid UTF-8
derivation: The provider name holds the bytes C3 28, which is not a UTF-8 sequence (JSON-1).

vectors.title: A string holds an unpaired surrogate escape
derivation: The provider name holds the escape \ud800, a high surrogate that no low-surrogate escape follows (JSON-1).

vectors.title: Arrays nest 513 deep
derivation: The document is 513 nested arrays; the limit is 512 (JSON-1). It is refused as text, before it is judged as a catalog.
